about_p1: CELESTÉ HOUSE is the ideal destination for connoisseurs of exquisite European cuisine. With a luxurious, meticulous, and charming ambiance, we offer a world-class dining experience.
about_p2: In particular, our signature Wagyu beef dish has established our reputation, masterfully prepared by world-class chefs to preserve its rich, traditional flavor.
dish_wagyu_desc: Premium Japanese beef, perfectly grilled with absolute tenderness.
dish_duck_desc: Traditional French slow-cooked duck with crispy skin and melt-in-your-mouth meat.
dish_lobster_desc: Classic French baked lobster with cheese, offering a rich and elegant flavor.
cta_desc: Experience a romantic dinner in the luxurious atmosphere of CELESTÉ HOUSE
